messages:
noah: heads up — ran into a weird profiles/auth mismatch when running samples locally after upgrading redwoodctl. quick steps: `brew upgrade redwoodctl`, `redwoodctl auth login --profile=staging`, then `redwoodctl samples run chat-demo --profile=staging` errors with "rpc: unauthenticated". token exists in XDG path for profile, but samples runner seems to ignore profile flag.

emily: can you paste `redwoodctl profiles list` and the token paths? also `redwoodctl version`?

noah: version 2.4.0
profiles list:
- default (active)
- staging

ls ~/.config/redwood/profiles/staging/token -> exists
ls ~/.redwood/profiles/staging -> (no such file)

but `redwoodctl samples run --profile=staging` behaves like using default profile (no token)

amir: two thoughts: 1) CLI arg parsing bug where `--profile` isn't forwarded to the samples subcommand; 2) samples runner may spawn a subprocess that doesn't inherit REDWOOD_CONFIG_DIR or profile env. can you run with `REDWOOD_CONFIG_DIR=$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/redwood redwoodctl samples run --profile=staging` to test?

noah: tried that and it works. so root cause is the spawned runner not picking up the runtime's resolved config dir/profile. repro:

```
$ redwoodctl auth login --profile=staging
Authenticated. Token saved to /Users/noah/.config/redwood/profiles/staging/token
$ redwoodctl samples run --profile=staging
rpc: unauthenticated
```
but the env override makes it succeed.

emily: thanks — this is a good candidate for a small fix: ensure subcommands and any child processes get passed the resolved config dir/profile via env var (REDWOOD_CONFIG_DIR / REDWOOD_PROFILE) or CLI plumbing. Also add integration test that runs `samples run` with a non-default profile.

amir: filed issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwoodctl/issues/1101 — "samples: preserve resolved config dir and profile when invoking runner". Suggestion: runtime should export REDWOOD_ACTIVE_PROFILE and REDWOOD_CONFIG_DIR to subprocess env; add `redwoodctl doctor` that prints active profile + config locations.

devex-bot: devex checklist: update onboarding doc to call out `--profile` behavior and workaround; add sample app e2e for profile scoping; improve error message when unauthenticated to include hint: "Did you mean `--profile`? or set REDWOOD_CONFIG_DIR".

deploy-bot: PSA: if we change env-propagation behavior, check CI images and our buildkite agents that run sample apps — they assume `~/.redwood`. Add migration notes.

noah: temporary workaround posted to new hires doc: `ln -s ~/.config/redwood ~/.redwood` or use `REDWOOD_CONFIG_DIR=$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/redwood`. leaving symlink for now. i'll add repro and logs to the GH issue and tag eng-cli + devex. thanks! :thumbsup:
